note: A 48 MB memory limit is below Caddy's peak during TLS handshakes and compression, so the kernel kills the proxy again and again and every site, the status page included, refuses connections.

cause.title: fix: limit memory, cpu and processes of the proxy
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -20,6 +20,10 @@ services:
     cap_drop: [ALL]
     cap_add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE]
     security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    # Same kind of limits as the project stacks; Caddy idles at about 30 MB
+    mem_limit: 48m
+    cpus: 1
+    pids_limit: 64
     restart: unless-stopped
     # json-file only rotates by size; the time limit comes from host/journald-retention.conf
     logging:
